messages.text:
What it is: Auto-hibernate fires when backlog is drained — coordinator must not self-generate during quiescence
What it solves: RELATED: BL-307 (auto-hibernate base feature), BL-311 (intake archive hygiene),
BL-314-317 (coordinator self-generated tickets that revealed the defect).
How it works: Hibernation fires when backlog is drained and all roles are idle
